notes.title: Update 2.2.0 Starhenge City Release and Permanent Seasonal Events

Content Update 2.2.0 includes the release of the long-awaited Starhenge City! All seasonal events have also been changed to permanent events!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25995297/153f9d8cd2c140f681a92609277612f13dbb6369.gif[/img]

[u][b]PATCH NOTES[/b][/u]

[u]Starhenge City[/u]

[i]Starhenge City had seen the rest of the world of Orake become corrupted as the wildlife became monsters. Instead of trying to fix the problem, they built a cube to protect their society from the terrors outside. Inside the cube is a haven of resources collected and grown before the transformations began. They are highly protective of it and have fortified it with defenses on multiple levels. Starhenge City is known for selfishly protecting its own and not helping outsiders. Nearby Mystica was tormented by not only monsters, but also pirates. And Starhenge did nothing to help out for fear of weakening its own defenses. Gorgraxis was attracted by this selfish ambition and wished to consume them and their resources all the more. The Starhenge residents decided to take advantage of this as an additional defense and to this day Gorgraxis can still be found wandering the cube.[/i]

Unlocking Starhenge City will grant you access to abundant fishing, mining, woodcutting, and gathering spots previously restricted to the residents of Starhenge City. Even if you manage to complete the cube key unlocking the city, the citizens of Starhenge City are still apprehensive of outsiders and prefer to seclude themselves within their haven. Starhenge King tasks you with repairing some of the damage caused to the cube by Gorgraxis over the years. And in return will provide you with the fastest axe and pickaxe in game. However, some of the damaged areas can be hard to find.

[u]Permanent Seasonal Events[/u]

Every seasonal event has now found a permanent place in Orake!
[list]
[*] Easter Event
[*] Both Halloween Events (Jack O. Lanterns and the Hallowed Guides)
[*] Thanksgiving/Turkey Day Event
[*] Atnas Christmas Event
[/list]
All of the rewards from the events are available to all in-game as well through the normal ways to acquire them. Missed an event before? Want to get your hands on one of those seasonal cosmetics? Talk to Senna Loveseat in Aracia to be sent to our new Event HUB.

[u]Other Changes[/u]
[list]
[*] Changed Cartoon Mask #1, Cartoon Mask #2, and Cartoon Mask #1 (P) names to Pumpkin Mask, Cursed Pumpkin Mask and Purple Pumpkin Mask respectively
[*] Replaced the "Pumpkin Head" item in the Hallowed Shop with the "Purple Pumpkin Mask" item resolving a duplicate identical item
[*] Nerfed Hallowed Event EXP gains (Mining/WC and the combat Reward drinks)
[*] Nerfed Skilling Turkey EXP gains (from consuming them, crafting them gives no experience)
[*] Bloca Teleport cooldown reduced from 400 seconds to 240 seconds
[*] All tiers of the StaSta potions no longer give an empty bottle on use
[*] Whitecoal is now craftable as intended
[*] The Boneyard (W) map drops items on player death. Everywhere in the boneyard drops your inventory (and boots) when you die, be careful!
[*] Added two recipes to the Hachi/Ajnin recipe tree to further prevent players from getting stuck when crafting the Hachi's Kudomaskutai
[/list]
Minor update to fix cache issue

notes.title: Update 2.1.0 Announcement and Patch Notes!
notes.content:
Today, we are releasing content update 2.1.0! Its main features are a keybind editor, boss kill counter, and new equippable item types: Gloves and Necklaces! 

Gloves will usually possess some stats, but most importantly some unique passive effects intended to shake up gameplay a bit. Necklaces will be items with random stats, grant random unique spells while equipped, and will be rerollable using Soulstones (regular and Large, depending on the tier) to get the perfect stats and spell you want!

Necklaces will not be released immediately because more work needs to be done so they behave as intended. However, there will three Gloves available right away! More info on what they do and how to get them will be in the patch notes below.



[u][b]PATCH NOTES[/b][/u]

[u]System Changes[/u]
• Implemented a keybind editor. You can access it from the Options menu or pressing default key "\".
• Added support for two new equippable item types: Necklaces and Gloves.
• Added a Boss kill counter (for real this time!).
• The main menu will now show your client version in the top-right corner.
• Revamped the instancing system to avoid potentially overwriting existing permanent maps.
• Reduced the sound effect volume for linear spells.
• Added two more screen resolution options: 1024x576 and 1152x648.
• Fixed a crash related to the config file that may occur when launching the client.
• Fixed a bug when dying in the Boneyard that showed red text "Your inventory is full" even if you had nothing equipped.

[u]General Changes[/u]
• Skeleton Archers now have items in their drop table. Their spawn points are now accessible.
• Added a new Gloves item, Bloody Gloves: Grants damage equal to your combat level while unarmed. Dropped by Rockwort Goblins @ 1/250. No level requirement.
• Added a new Gloves item, Magnetic Gloves: Grants a 50% chance not to consume ammo. Dropped by Skeleton Archers @ 1/250. Requires 55 Archery to equip.
• Added a new Gloves item, Manafont Gloves: Grants a 10% chance for your casted spells not to consume mana. Dropped by Mystical Trees @ 1/250. Requires 60 Sorcery to equip.
• Changed the animation for Spike Blade (D)'s Rage attack.
• Changed the sprites of Archangels, Deramaus', and each of the Minotaurs.
• Death Worm: Replaced the 2x T4 Crate drop with Death Worm Egg (R) @ 1/1000.
• Rali: Halved the drop rate on all Ancient Masks and the Angel Ring.
• Old Sailor's Shop: Rounded cooked fish prices and increased prices of non-cooked fish.

notes.title: Orake Classic 2.0.0: Naitpyge Desert Out Now!
notes.content:
[b]Orake Classic update 2.0.0 is out now![/b] It features a new area: the Naitpyge Desert and its new town named Aerapoelc.

You can get there by taking Suribo's other boat from Sandy Port. While you're chatting with him, ask him about the crashed ships all over the Desert, maybe you can help him figure out the cause and bring some relief to voyagers. 

The Desert is filled with lots of new endgame content, but also has appeal to mid-level players, as well as low-level combat weapons. There are new resources, Golden tools, monsters, bosses, 20+ maps, Slayer tier and endgame dungeon, two sets of armor, four sets of weapons, and cosmetics!

[u]New Weapon Type: Sabres[/u]
Sabres are faster and more accurate, but weaker variants of swords. They follow the same tier scheme as swords, currently ranging from Bronze to Puka. These are not currently craftable, but sold by Omar in Aerapoelc after helping him to get access to his shop.

[u]Obsidian Equipment[/u]
This gear set will require level 110 of your combat skill (120 for weapons) and 85 Endurance. Using the new resources, you will have to craft an unstable Faded version of the equipment, which will then need to be stabilized with enhanced souls that can be bought, crafted, and dropped by certain monsters.

[u]Elemental Weapons and Spell[/u]
A new set of weapons with unique abilities and a new spell will be added for level 115 combat skills. Each one is dropped by one of the four new Royal Stag bosses with the associated element.

[u]Slayer Expansion[/u]
Slayer has been further expanded in 3 parts:

[i]a. Tier 7 Slayer [/i]
You will now be able to accept tier 7 Slayer tasks at Combat Level 70 and level 100 Slayer in the Slayer Chamber. The rewards will be greatly increased compared to T6 at the cost of more difficult new monsters.

[i]b. Relic Gear Set:[/i]
Along with the Slayer expansion, there will be a new base set of gear for Slayers that can be combined in your own way to make stronger gear. The base items are comprised of five base helmets and two base tops and bottoms with different stats, defensive and offensive. Base level requirements are 60 Slayer and level 30 Combat. Combined versions will have greater requirements but greater stats. Combinations can be made on Slayer Altars. Base items can be dropped by Slayer monsters as early as Tier 3, becoming more common up to Tier 7, also in Tier 5+ Slayer crates.

[i]c. The Slayer Realm[/i]
A new Slayer quest line begins in the Desert about the warring Ajnin and Kusari factions. After completion and with level 100 Slayer, you will be able to access the end-game dungeon and defeat its difficult boss from the Elemental Citadel or Desert. This boss will drop an item used to finish upgrading your fully combined Slayer Relic gear. He will also drop new Slayer weapons that have similar requirements to the final Slayer gear, also with extreme power.

[u]New God Boss: Graab[/u]
Graab can be accessed in the southwest corner of Underground Power similarly to other gods. He will also drop the new tier of Slayer weapons, relic gear, and other useful and lucrative items.

[u]New Tools and Resources[/u]
There is a new set of Golden tools with high requirements at level 110 skills (except Woodcutting at level 90). Each skill has received at least one new resource to collect from or recipe to craft. These will be available after the current highest level of skilling content.

[u]New Cosmetics[/u]
We've added another cosmetics chest filled with 15 new cosmetics to Aracia as well as in Aerapoelc.

As always, thank you for your continued support and please tell us your opinion on this huge expansion, what are you most excited for? The wiki will start being updated before release and we can possibly provide some specific sneak peeks if requested. Feel free to leave suggestions, ask us questions, and give feedback!

Additionally, the sequel being made in Unity is still in production and coming along quite smoothly, stay tuned for more updates on that as it progresses! ːsteamhappyː

And to commemorate this major update, we are going to provide a 4hr bless tonight, 07 FEB 2020, at 6-10pm EST (10 pm - 2 am GMT)!

notes.title: ORAKE CLASSIC IS NOW ONLINE!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Orake Classic is now online live on Steam! If you have any issues running the game, please visit the Discord's troubleshooting channel at https://discord.gg/yzbRwJK or see current known issues below and how to troubleshoot them.

Troubleshooting Tips:

1. The game not working, wrong .exe found, etc.

First try to restart Steam or verify the integrity of files (right-clicking Orake Classic > Properties > Local Files > Verify Integrity of Game Files to update the game.)

If that doesn't work, then you might have to reinstall the game completely. Select uninstall from the right click menu, then reinstall after that has completed. Note that this will remove your saved username/password, so you might want to go into your install directory's config.ini to see what it was.

2. Runtime error 339: mswinsck.ocx missing.

This is a file that is missing from your sys32 folder in your windows install directory. Navigate to the game's local files (right click Orake Classic -> Properties -> Local Files tab -> Browse Local Files). Then, run the "runtime.exe" file in that folder. Finally, try running your game again.
[i]Update: We have set a launch option for this on Steam. Make sure you install the runtime on the proper drive where you have Windows installed. [/i]

If this still doesn't work, please message "gooby" in game or on Discord to help you manually install the file.

More updates to come! Enjoy the new formula changes and Halloween events. See you in game or in the Discord!

gooby

notes.title: This is the announcement everyone has been waiting for!
notes.content:
The original Orake has been Reborn and servers are now ONLINE!
 
[url=https://oomst.itch.io/orake-reborn]Download the Game on ITCH[/url]
 
All old characters and accounts have been wiped and everyone will be starting new. This re-release of the original game will be hosted indefinitely and will be free to play. There have been no major updates to the main game engine, but some minor changes have been made to general gameplay as well as the member system. See the release notes below for Orake Reborn details and changes that have been made.


Orake Reborn v1.1.0 Release Notes

 
    All accounts have been removed and players will need to create a new account to access the game. This clears the overloaded player account lists which will improve gameplay performance, but also improve the in-game economy that was imbalanced due to exploits or purchased game advantages over the years.
    A new install of the game will be required. You will no longer be able to access the game from the old install. Orake Reborn has an improved installer package and can be downloaded immediately from our page on [url=https://oomst.itch.io/orake-reborn]Itch.io[/url]. The game will also be released on Steam sometime in the next few weeks as well but will exclusively be available via [url=https://oomst.itch.io/orake-reborn]Itch.io[/url] for the initial release.  
    Website purchases for in-game items will no longer be available, however we will still be accepting donations to help with game hosting and maintenance. The donations can be made via the [url=https://oomst.itch.io/orake-reborn]Itch.io[/url] website during download or through PayPal found on the [url=https://orakereborn.com]Orake Reborn website[/url].

    Membership in-game is now open and free to everyone. Some member only features have been modified slightly to allow all users to access. If you had membership previously you will be given Member status on the discord server – new players and previous players who did not have membership will not be able to purchase the exclusive member designation. Additional benefits may be added in the future as well and will be announced if implemented.

    In-game feature modification highlights:
      New tutorial options have been added.
        Ork Coins will have an increased drop rate and are now tradeable. Ork Coin Boxes are also now available.
        Cosmetic shop items have now been made more affordable and some will be available to purchase from Slayer NPCs.
        Server Blesses will be triggered via skilling.
        Membership warps open to all, and are now level based.
        The Easter event is now permanently active along with the pet token shop.
        New cosmetics have been added as loot drops from various bosses!
        Be on the look-out for a new in-game storyline which is directly related to the new game! 

Note that no new content will be added to the original game. In-game bug reports will still be accepted but will be carefully reviewed to determine if a fix will be implemented. The goal is to keep the servers online and playable and only high severity issues will be addressed moving forward. We will now be focusing our development efforts on the sequel which is currently being developed with a modern game engine and will be much easier for us to update and add new content. It will also provide players a more stable and scalable world to explore while supporting a larger online population. We will be posting news and updates as we continue development. An Alpha release will be planned within the next couple of months to open testing to a small group of players. If you would like to be part of the Alpha testing be aware that we will be choosing the group based on how active you are in Orake Reborn and your level of interaction with us outside of the game.

The comments and feedback from the original player base drove our motivation to reopen the servers and continue development of the game sequel. We encourage everyone to post feedback and interact with us as we move forward with new development. While the original Orake will no longer include memberships or a coin shop we also ask for everyone to consider a small donation to help with server costs moving forward to keep the game alive.
 

The main thing we ask of those who were the most vocal about the game going down is simply this: PLAY THE GAME! Get your friends to play, log on often, and help us get word out that the game is once again alive and we have some exciting plans for the future!

Oomst Games would also like to publicly thank the players that volunteered their time over the last few weeks. Their continued ideas, effort, and passion for the game is what made this re-release a reality. They have also been an inspiration to us to keep the game alive and move forward with the new game development.

THANK YOU, Meisnereffect, Zacuum, Dude, GodKindToro, Robstinator, Lazoh, and last but not least Clairance!

notes.title: A new Orake.
notes.content:
@@Hello Orake fans and thank you!@@

We have concluded our first early access test and will be down for aproximately 1 week for some HUGE, serious content and bugfix updates. Any problems that were discovered in the initial launch can/will be fixed and updated for our next launch. 

@@Some of the updates that will follow our next launch include:@@

-Rebalanced PvP and PvE content, to give all fighting types a fighting chance!

-Skills will be and feel less "grindy" by containing much more content and balanced experience rates. Kiss those content gaps goodbye.

-Pets function as intended with good stats/skills and no longer roam aimlessly.

-Lots of new areas to explore, filled with new monsters to kill - resources to skill & secrets to unveil.

-Lag/server issues are sorted out. Early access allowed us to pinpoint and solve nearly all of the server issues we experienced in the past, expect a much smoother experience.
